# FoodShield AI

> Open-data dashboard that scores how exposed each country's food supply is to shocks: trade dependency, climate, conflict and logistics. It covers 193 countries and 50 US states, refreshes from public sources every six hours, and gives every figure its source and date. The Food Disruption Risk Score (FDRS) measures exposure to supply shocks, not how many people are hungry now; hunger indicators are shown separately. Built by Fedde Vreeken.

## El Niño 2026-27

- [El Niño and the food supply](https://www.foodshield.nl/elnino): ocean state, NOAA and BoM indices, rain and sea temperature now, the seasonal outlook, and past El Niños for comparison
- [Harvests](https://www.foodshield.nl/elnino/harvests): crop yield responses to El Niño fitted on FAOSTAT yields since 1961, the tonnes at stake and who would have to import more
- [Shipping](https://www.foodshield.nl/elnino/shipping): Panama Canal water level and transits, chokepoints from IMF PortWatch, river gauges and grain ports
- [Food prices](https://www.foodshield.nl/elnino/prices): staple prices from FAO GIEWS and the World Bank against past El Niño price paths
- [Reported impacts](https://www.foodshield.nl/elnino/reported): floods, droughts and export decisions from GDACS, ReliefWeb and agency bulletins
- [How El Niño works](https://www.foodshield.nl/elnino/mechanism): trade winds, the Walker circulation, the warm pool and upwelling, each step with this week's readings

## Dashboard

- [Global map](https://www.foodshield.nl/): FDRS for every country
- [Country & Flows](https://www.foodshield.nl/countryflows): one country's trade, climate, governance and conflict indicators; add the country to the path, for example https://www.foodshield.nl/countryflows/egypt
- [Staple crops](https://www.foodshield.nl/commodities): producers, importers and supplier concentration, for example https://www.foodshield.nl/commodities/wheat
- [Disturbances](https://www.foodshield.nl/disturbances): hazards, conflict and export restrictions
- [News](https://www.foodshield.nl/news): food and commodity headlines matched to the trade corridors they touch; headlines are publisher claims
- [Stress test](https://www.foodshield.nl/scenario): shock one country and see which constraint breaks first
- [2030 outlook](https://www.foodshield.nl/outlook): today's structural score rescored for population and food-output trends to 2030; not a prediction
- [Rankings](https://www.foodshield.nl/rankings): every country by score
- [Compare](https://www.foodshield.nl/compare): up to four countries side by side
- [Companies](https://www.foodshield.nl/companies): sourcing countries of major grain traders and fertilizer producers, from their own filings
- [Live data](https://www.foodshield.nl/livedata): FAO Food Price Index and World Bank Pink Sheet benchmarks
- [Data status](https://www.foodshield.nl/datastatus): every feed, its last refresh and its health
- [Methodology](https://www.foodshield.nl/methodology): how the score is built and checked, and what it leaves out
- [About](https://www.foodshield.nl/about): what FoodShield measures and who built it

## Data (JSON, CC BY 4.0)

- [countries.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/countries.json): scores and inputs per country, each field with source, date, method and quality flag
- [source_manifest.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/source_manifest.json): every feed with its status and last refresh
- [fdrs_history.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/fdrs_history.json): daily structural FDRS snapshot per country
- [trade_matrix.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/trade_matrix.json): importer-exporter food corridors in tonnes, from the FAOSTAT Detailed Trade Matrix
- [trade_restrictions.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/trade_restrictions.json): food and fertilizer export restrictions on record, each checked against its notification or a wire report
- [gdacs.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/gdacs.json): drought, flood and cyclone alerts from GDACS
- [reliefweb_alerts.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/reliefweb_alerts.json): food and nutrition reports from ReliefWeb
- [fao_ffpi.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/fao_ffpi.json): FAO Food Price Index
- [fpma_prices.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/fpma_prices.json): staple food price changes per country from FAO GIEWS FPMA
- [portwatch.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/portwatch.json): daily transits through maritime chokepoints from IMF PortWatch
- [commodity_news.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/commodity_news.json): publisher headlines, each a claim, not measured data
- [enso.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso.json): ONI record, weekly Niño regions and analog years from NOAA CPC
- [enso_indices.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso_indices.json): ONI, RONI, weekly Niño 3.4 (NOAA CPC) and BoM relative Niño 3.4 and SOI
- [sst_anomaly.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/sst_anomaly.json): seven-day sea-surface temperature anomaly grid from NOAA OISST
- [rain_anomaly.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/rain_anomaly.json): recent rain against the 1991-2020 normal from NOAA CPC gauges
- [seasonal_outlook.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/seasonal_outlook.json): NOAA CPC NMME seasonal outlook
- [enso_model.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso_model.json): fitted El Niño yield responses per crop and country (model output)
- [enso_exposure.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso_exposure.json): production-weighted El Niño harvest effect per country (model output; a direction, not a magnitude)
- [enso_lanes.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso_lanes.json): Panama Canal and river shipping lanes with advisories and past El Niño precedents
- [enso_price_analogs.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso_price_analogs.json): real maize price paths per country through past El Niños
- [enso_recent_events.json](https://www.foodshield.nl/data/enso_recent_events.json): reported El Niño impacts, each with its source

## Reading the site

- Solid lines and frames are observed data; dashed or hatched ones are published expectations or model output.
- A value with no source is not shown: the site leaves the field empty rather than estimating it.
- Code: https://github.com/feddevreeken-ctrl/foodshield-ai
